nodes.description: AMPK carrying the R531Q gamma-2 subunit shows enhanced basal activity and increased phosphorylation of the alpha catalytic subunit, so its activity no longer tracks the cellular energy charge. The defining study reports that the classic PRKAG2 alleles push in the same direction to a lesser degree. For R384T, loss of stress-induced activation was reported instead, so the activity change may not be uniform across lethal alleles.

nodes.description: Recurrent CBS-domain missense allele (c.1592G>A) found as an identical heterozygous substitution in unrelated sporadic patients, de novo where parents were tested. The recombinant protein loses more than 100-fold of its binding affinity for AMP and ATP while gaining basal kinase activity. Every reported carrier with fetal or infantile presentation died within months. At the same codon, p.Arg531Gly causes a hypertrophy-free childhood-onset pre-excitation phenotype (see `PRKAG2_Cardiac_Syndrome`).
